voice: third-person, formal, consultative (explicit workflow requirement); the synthetic prior report contains no prose, so voice is not observable in it
tense: past tense for observed states and measurements during the quarter; present tense for standing facts and recommendations (explicit workflow requirement); the synthetic prior report contains no sentences to confirm this
sentence_style: declarative sentences with one claim per sentence and a clear subject and verb (explicit workflow requirement); the synthetic prior report contains no prose sentences, so this is not observable in it
phrasing_conventions: Metric labels are 'MFA coverage' and 'Managed devices', each paired with a single value cell
Percentage values are written with a percent sign and no decimals (90%)
Counts are written as bare integers (10)
formatting_conventions: Document title is a single H1 heading
Assessment sections are H2 headings in this order: Identity Security, then Device Security
Each section contains one two-column markdown table with header row 'Metric | Value'
The prior report carries a blockquote line marking it as a synthetic test fixture
banned_patterns: colloquialisms, filler, and marketing language (explicit workflow requirement)
internal classification labels such as Regressed, Improved, and Unable to validate as report text, because that convention is not present in the prior report (explicit workflow requirement)
